{{Quote|''[customer yells and whimpers]'' Come on. Scram.'' [whimpering] ''And don't come back until you pay your debts, you deadbeat.|A casino owner, to a customer|<ref name="TOTU 104" />|audio=YouDeadbeat.mp3}}
At some point between around [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TalesDate|U4}}</ref> a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="TOTU 104" /> '''Rodian''' was present on [[Duro]], where they visited<ref name="TOTU 104" /> a secret [[Unidentified casino (Duro)|casino]]<ref name="TOTU 104 ST">{{TOTU|The Good Life}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> in the back of [[The Corner Shop]]. Ultimately, the individual was booted out through a door backing onto a dark street alley by the [[Unidentified kingpin|casino owner]], who instructed the patron to scram, standing next to a [[Unidentified Twi'lek casino worker|Twi'lek companion]]. As the [[Rodian]] ran away, the kingpin screamed for them to warn them against coming back until they had paid all their debts. The indcident was witnessed by the two [[Duros]]<ref name="TOTU 104" /> boys<ref name="TOTU 104 AD" /> [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]], who happened to have stood behind the [[casino]] owner's back the whole [[time]].<ref name="TOTU 104" />

A [[Color|green]]-skinned<ref name="TOTU 104" /> male<ref name="TOTU 104 AD" /> Rodian with light-blue [[eye]]s, the customer was dressed in a white, sleeveless [[Clothing|jacket]] worn over a light-blue top.<ref name="TOTU 104" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian customer made their [[canon]]ical debut in the "[[The Good Life]]," an episode of the animated television miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'',<ref name="TOTU 104" /> which was released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref>
